Per the project's recorded decision, tax uses banker's rounding (`decimal.ROUND_HALF_EVEN`), never `ROUND_HALF_UP`. The rule is applied to each line item separately, and the rounded line taxes are then summed. The invoice total is never rounded. The decision came out of a March 2026 review with the finance team, after customers reported invoices that were off by a cent.

The code doesn't show this yet. `src/billing/tax.py` has no rounding calls and no `ROUND_*` constants anywhere in `src`. Either the rounding isn't implemented yet or it happens somewhere I didn't find. Don't treat the code as proof that the rule is enforced.

The project also has a convention that all money is integer cents, using the `Money` type in `src/billing/money.py`, with no floats.
